name: Greta Mosshoof
summary: At the Emerald Sanctuary, Greta Mosshoof works to stop the corruption spreading through Felwood. She stands with the Emerald Circle and other guardians of nature, studying the taint and sending scouts into Jaedenar.

sections.title: Guardian of the Forest
sections.body: At Felwood’s southern edge, Greta Mosshoof works from the Emerald Sanctuary with the Emerald Circle. Corruption is consuming the ancient woods. Greta and her allies seek to understand the spreading rot and push it back. Her investigations follow Felwood’s poisoned waters and the foul cultists hidden within Jaedenar.

sections.title: Striking at the Shadow Council
sections.body: Greta Mosshoof directs efforts against the Shadow Council in Jaedenar. Its corrupted springs and foul wards feed the sickness choking Felwood. She sends travelers to sample the tainted waters and seek help from Islen Waterseer on the distant coast. They must also destroy the ritual braziers that shield the demonic cabal from intrusion.

faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof works with the Emerald Circle at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. She aids travelers and druids investigating and undoing the demonic blight poisoning the forest.

faq.q: What faction does Greta Mosshoof belong to?
aliases: is greta mosshoof horde or alliance
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof belongs to the Emerald Circle, a neutral organization devoted to healing nature. She guides both Alliance and Horde adventurers.

faq.q: Why is Greta sending adventurers into Jaedenar?
faq.answer: Jaedenar is the Shadow Council’s stronghold in Felwood. The council pumps demonic bile into the waterways and maintains wards that shelter demons. Greta sends travelers to break its rituals and purify the blighted springs.

faq.q: What is Greta Mosshoof's connection to Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof is friends with Islen Waterseer, a wise shaman who lives along the coast of the Barrens. After Greta finds corrupt water samples from Felwood, she sends travelers to seek Islen’s spiritual mastery and purify the fluid. Then it can cleanse the poisoned springs.

angles.text: As a druid, you see how the Cenarion Circle sets faction ties aside to restore Kalimdor’s wilderness and heal the scars of the Burning Legion.
As a tauren, you see Greta’s devotion to healing the Earth Mother’s wounds, even far north in lands once guarded solely by the night elves.
